description: Zambia - MInGov is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by Helga Treichel (World Bank Group). The Mining Investment and Governance Review (MInGov) analyzes the sector and its context to facilitate work on mining regulation, governance and investment. By June 2016, MInGov will have completed and published assessments of nine countries using a consistent, measurable, comparable and actionable methodology. Coverage: Zambia. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
